queries.text: Why did the EU's AI Act enter into force in phases between 2024 and 2027, and what do the different deadlines require?
Date the EU AI Act entered into force and specific dates for each phase of application between 2024 and 2027
List of prohibited AI practices under Article 5 and their effective date in February 2025
Regulatory requirements for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III and their compliance deadline in August 2026
Obligation to comply with transparency obligations for certain AI systems (e.g., deepfakes, chatbots) and its effective date in August 2025
Requirements for general-purpose AI models regarding technical documentation, copyright policies, and training data summaries and their applicable timeline from August 2025
Penalties and fines structure for non-compliance with the EU AI Act including maximum fine amounts as a percentage of global turnover

search_hits.title: The EU AI Act's phased entry into force (2024-2027)
search_hits.snippet: The EU AI Act — the world's first comprehensive AI law — entered into force 2024-08-01 with obligations phased through 2027.
